name: pbpk_renal_impairment_chain
display_name: PBPK Renal/Hepatic Impairment — Virtual Patient Simulation
description: Mechanistic PBPK simulation for organ-impaired patient populations required for IND/NDA regulatory submissions. Begins with allometric scaling to estimate human PK from preclinical data, runs the PBPK impairment submodel (renal or hepatic), then virtual patient cohort sampling for variability characterization. Used for Phase II dose selection and label recommendations in special populations.
